objective.description: Repair the local access policy over the listed observable inputs.
objective.success_criterion: Return allow for authorized finite-domain cases and deny for unauthorized cases.

documents.text: Perform server-side authorization for each requested resource and operation using trusted identity and policy data. A hard-to-guess object identifier is not a substitute for an access decision.
Restrict file operations to the intended directory after resolving the effective path. Consider relative traversal, absolute paths, and alternate encodings; preserve access to permitted files.

task_card.description: Submit a JSON decision table for the observable inputs. The checker may provide feedback after each attempt.
task_card.title: Local finite-domain authorization policy
task_card.visible_initial_state: A starter policy is available for local evaluation.
